messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - inference-runtime errors spike for model 'rw-v3-medium' in us-west-2. Elevated 5xx rate (>= 12%) and token latency > 2s. Auto-fallback triggered. Links: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/alerts/1758001234 :rotating_light:
Ava (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing 504s from runtime instances behind pool-dedicated-3. Any recent deploys? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.12-2321 completed to pool-dedicated-3 at 1757989000 (no failures reported).
Ava (oncall): OK, starting quick triage. Priya, can you check KV cache error rates? I suspect cache contention after the quantized rollout yesterday.
Priya (runtime): Looking at the KV store metrics now. There's a spike in kv-miss latency and ~30% increase in evictions. Also seeing a pattern of repeated cache-invalidations from batching worker (batcher-7). Logs: ```ERROR kv_cache.cpp:289 evicting stale key set_id=0x4f3a reason=collision```
Lee (sre): FYI I've repro'd high queue depth on batcher-7. It looks like an interaction between larger batch windows and the new quantized kernel's memory pattern -> GC pressure.
Ava (oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) disable KV cache on the affected pool (fast but increases costs), 2) reduce batch max_window to 8 on pool-dedicated-3, 3) rollback yesterday quantized kernel for rw-v3-medium. Thoughts?
Priya (runtime): I can flip (2) quickly via runtime-config and watch. (1) is heavier and will cause token cost jump. Rollback (3) requires canary and ~10min. Recommend 2 first.
Ava (oncall): Do it. Priya, please apply batch_window=8 to pool-dedicated-3 and throttle batcher concurrency to 0.6. Notify when live. :thumbsup:
Priya (runtime): Pushed config change at 1758010123. batch_window=8 applied, batcher concurrency=0.6. Observability: starting to see reduced queue depth.
Marta (support): Any customer-facing impact? Support queue has a few reports of slow responses from a handful of enterprise customers. I opened a support incident and flagged for SRE.
Ava (oncall): Current customer impact: degraded latency for ~120 active sessions across 4 customers; no full unavailability. We'll keep support updated.
Lee (sre): After config change, 5xxs dropped from 12% -> 2.1% in 7 minutes, token latency median from 1.9s -> 1.1s. Still elevated but improving.
Ava (oncall): Good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. Sam, you need to pick this up for night handoff if it persists.
Sam (next-oncall): Copy. I'll join handoff at 1758030000. If regressions rise above 5% or rollback requested, I'll execute rollback plan.
Priya (runtime): Follow-ups: we should revert the batch window change to default after a fix, and also add guardrails in the autotuner to avoid batch windows that interact poorly with quantized kernels.
Ava (oncall): Agreed. Scheduling post-incident review: propose 2026-03-13 16:00 UTC (postmortem). I'll create the postmortem doc and action list.
Priya (runtime): Action items I will own: (A) root-cause analysis of kv eviction pattern (JIRA INF-4521), (B) autotuner guardrail design doc (JIRA INF-4522). ETA 1 week for A, 2 weeks for B.
Lee (sre): I'll own operational mitigations: (C) add automated runbook step to detect high kv eviction and autoscale batcher or reduce batch window (JIRA SRE-7788). ETA 3 days for initial alert + 2 weeks for automation.
Marta (support): I'll prepare customer notes and a short timeline to send to affected customers. JIRA SUP-3344.
Ava (oncall): Linking action items and owners in the postmortem. Short-term remediation plan in the thread: 1) Monitor 1h, if 5xx > 5% for 15m -> rollback quantized kernel (Sam). 2) If latency still >1.5s after 30m -> disable KV cache temporarily (Priya + SRE). 3) Metrics to watch: kv-evictions/s, batcher-queue-depth, 5xx-rate, token-latency-p50/p95.
Sam (next-oncall): Acknowledged. I'll be on-call and can roll back if needed.
Ava (oncall): Wrapping up monitoring window. Current status at 1758056789: 5xx=1.8%, p95 latency 2.2s (still a bit high), batcher queue depth normalized. We'll call this mitigated for now and proceed with postmortem and the three JIRAs.
Priya (runtime): Noted. I'll start RCA and add logs/trace collection for failing KV operations.
Ava (oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem invite and doc (internal) incoming. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollback playbooks available: https://internal.playbooks/redwood/rollback-quant-kernel.md
